WITH inputs AS (
 SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, u.displaydurmonths,
 CASE s.lightsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS light_weight,
 CASE s.tempsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS temp_weight,
 CASE s.humiditysensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS humidity_weight,
 l.lightlux, l.visibleexplxh,
 (r.histsignrating + r.researchvalrating + r.cultscore) * (10 - CASE a.conservestatus WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END) / 30.0 AS cpi
 FROM artifactscore a
 JOIN usagerecords u ON u.artrefused = a.artregistry
 JOIN sensitivitydata s ON s.sensitivityregistry = u.sensdatalink
 JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
 JOIN conditionassessments c ON c.artrefexamined = a.artregistry
 JOIN lightandradiationreadings l ON l.lightradregistry = c.lightreadrefobserved
 WHERE u.displayrotatesched = 'Active'
), metrics AS (
 SELECT *, 36.0 * (10 - light_weight) * (10 - temp_weight) * (10 - humidity_weight) / 1000.0 AS dsd,
 lightlux::numeric * light_weight * visibleexplxh / 1000.0 AS ler
 FROM inputs
), scores AS (
 SELECT *, (dsd - displaydurmonths) * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0 AS erps FROM metrics
)
SELECT artregistry AS artifact_id, artname AS artifact_name, mattype AS material_type,
 displaydurmonths AS current_display_duration_months, dsd AS display_limit_months,
 erps AS calculated_score,
 CASE WHEN erps < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation' ELSE 'Monitor' END AS recommendation
FROM scores
ORDER BY erps, artregistry
LIMIT 5;
